raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Customers migrated to the new CRM carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names, and silver_customers passes them through unchanged. raw_region_map covers all four codes (01=WEST, 02=EAST, 03=NORTH, 04=SOUTH), so the codes can be translated to names in silver_customers, and gold_region_daily then corrects itself.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(upper(m.region_name), upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON trim(c.region) = m.region_code"}}
